about: HypGraph's terms in each language the UI and the site speak. English is the source and authoritative. tests/test_i18n.py holds every translation to this file: where an English string uses a term, its translation uses one of the term's forms (a stem, matched without case). Change a term here and in every table together.

terms.note: a statement written into the record, bound to results; es afirmación, fr affirmation, de Behauptung, zh 主张
es hipótesis, fr hypothèse, de Hypothese, zh 假设
what the record derives about a node (checked, stale, at risk…): es situación, fr statut, de Stand, zh 现状. Not 'status' (a question's or order's state: es estado, fr état, de Status, zh 状态)
a newer node of the same type replaces it: es sustituye / sustituido, fr remplace / remplacé, de ersetzt, zh 取代 / 已被取代
taken back by its author: es retirado, fr retiré, de zurückgezogen, zh 已撤回
a reviewer's objection is open: es impugnado, fr contesté, de angefochten, zh 有争议
rests on a file or page that changed: es desactualizado, fr périmé, de veraltet, zh 过时

an independent reviewer checked it: es comprobado / sin comprobar, fr contrôlé / non contrôlé, de geprüft / ungeprüft, zh 已核查 / 未核查. Not 'verified' (the hash chain): es verificado, fr vérifié, de verifiziert, zh 已验证
the hash chain and the rows were re-checked: es verificar, fr vérifier, de verifizieren, zh 验证
a premise it rests on fell: es en riesgo, fr à risque, de gefährdet, zh 有风险
the hash of the last event in the chain: es cabeza, fr tête, de Head, zh 链头
es cadena de hashes, fr chaîne de hachage, de Hash-Kette, zh 哈希链
a hypgraph/1-bundle file: kept as 'bundle' in es / fr / de (it names the file format), zh 记录包
the investigation a bundle or a claim is limited to: es alcance, fr portée, de Geltungsbereich, zh 范围
the hash-chained research record (not checked by match: prose refers back to it with pronouns)
a task the harness hands a seat: es orden de trabajo, fr ordre de travail, de Arbeitsauftrag, zh 工单
es telemetría, fr télémétrie, de Telemetrie, zh 遥测
a claim saying more than its evidence: es sobreafirmación, fr affirmation excessive, de Überbehauptung, zh 过度主张
es investigación, fr enquête, de Untersuchung, zh 调查
es revisor / revisión, fr examinateur / examen, de Prüfer / Prüfung, zh 审查者 / 审查
one agent's place in a swarm: es puesto, fr poste, de Platz, zh 席位
es enjambre, fr essaim, de Schwarm, zh 智能体群
es rechazado, fr refusé, de abgelehnt, zh 拒绝
es evidencia, fr preuves, de Belege, zh 证据
es procedencia, fr provenance, de Herkunft, zh 出处
a workflow profile (scientific, software…): es perfil, fr profil, de Profil, zh 配置
a workflow's stages and the gate out of each: es etapa / compuerta, fr étape / seuil, de Phase / Schranke, zh 阶段 / 关卡
a seat's hold on a work order: es reserva, fr réservation, de Reservierung, zh 租约
the author that re-runs values (lab): es instrumento, fr instrument, de Instrument, zh 仪器
es bitácora de auditoría (not 'registro', which is the record), fr journal d'audit, de Audit-Log, zh 审计日志
